title: Orionx halts withdrawals ahead of permanent shutdown after $7M custody shortfall
summary:
The shutdown highlights the critical need for stringent regulatory oversight and transparency in cryptocurrency exchanges to protect investors.
The post Orionx halts withdrawals ahead of permanent shutdown after $7M custody shortfall appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Cryptocurrency exchange Orionx has announced it is halting customer withdrawals and preparing for a permanent shutdown. The closure follows a significant custody shortfall involving millions of dollars. The situation underscores ongoing concerns regarding transparency, risk management, and regulatory oversight within the digital asset exchange sector, leaving investors facing uncertainty regarding the recovery of their funds.

title: BlackRock quietly turns Bitcoin whales into Wall Street clients
summary:
BlackRock's strategy could reshape crypto asset management, making Bitcoin more accessible to high-net-worth individuals and smaller funds.
The post BlackRock quietly turns Bitcoin whales into Wall Street clients appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Asset management giant BlackRock is successfully attracting major Bitcoin holders and high-net-worth clients into traditional financial structures. This strategic shift is expected to reshape the crypto asset management landscape, potentially bridging the gap between decentralized digital assets and mainstream Wall Street finance by making Bitcoin more accessible to smaller investment funds and wealthy individuals.

title: STONK surges 250% to $140 million market cap as stock-paired Solana launchpad StonkFun pulls volume to Raydium and Jupiter
summary: The platform integrated with Raydium's LaunchLab on Saturday as RAY also saw gains of more than 40%.
content: Solana launchpad StonkFun has driven significant volume to decentralized platforms Raydium and Jupiter, pushing the STONK token up 250% to a market capitalization of $140 million. Following StonkFun's integration with Raydium's LaunchLab, the RAY token also experienced notable gains of over 40% as trading activity surged across the ecosystem.

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang declares AGI has arrived for many practical tasks
summary:
Nvidia's AGI claim could reshape AI industry standards, emphasizing economic productivity over traditional benchmarks, impacting AI development.
The post Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang declares AGI has arrived for many practical tasks appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang recently stated that artificial general intelligence has already arrived for various practical tasks. This development could significantly shift industry standards by prioritizing real-world economic productivity over traditional benchmarks. Such a milestone marks a major evolution in the trajectory of global artificial intelligence development and industry expectations.

title: Bitcoin Is Backed by Nothing? Peter Schiff Revives Old War
summary:
Peter Schiff reopens the Bitcoin backing controversy. He argues spent mining energy backs nothing, even as US debt climbs past $40 trillion.
The post Bitcoin Is Backed by Nothing? Peter Schiff Revives Old War appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Economist and critic Peter Schiff has reignited the long-standing controversy over Bitcoin. Schiff argued that money spent on mining energy ultimately backs nothing. This criticism comes at a time when United States national debt continues to climb significantly, surpassing the 40 trillion dollar threshold.

title: Ethereum sees resurgence as DeFi activity boosts meme coin interest
summary:
Ethereum's DeFi resurgence, fueled by meme coin interest, highlights shifting retail capital flows and potential volatility in crypto markets.
The post Ethereum sees resurgence as DeFi activity boosts meme coin interest appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Ethereum is experiencing a renewed market resurgence driven by a notable increase in decentralized finance activity. This growth is heavily supported by rising interest in meme coins, reflecting changing trends in retail capital flows. Market observers note that these shifting dynamics could introduce heightened potential volatility across the broader cryptocurrency sector as network participation evolves.

title: Microsoft, Cornell University unveil Free Pause Tokens method for efficient language model training
summary:
This innovation could democratize access to advanced AI by reducing resource demands, enabling broader deployment without infrastructure changes.
The post Microsoft, Cornell University unveil Free Pause Tokens method for efficient language model training appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Microsoft and Cornell University have introduced a new method called Free Pause Tokens to make language model training more efficient. This innovation aims to reduce resource demands and could democratize access to advanced artificial intelligence. By lowering infrastructure requirements, the approach enables broader deployment of AI models without needing significant hardware upgrades.

title: Attackers Leave On-chain Message After $320 Million Exits Liquid Network
summary:
$319 million left Blockstream's Liquid peg on Sunday. The wallet left a note. The chain says the peg still balances.
The post Attackers Leave On-chain Message After $320 Million Exits Liquid Network appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: On Sunday, a massive sum of approximately $320 million exited Blockstream's Liquid Network peg. Following the outflow, the attackers left an on-chain message attached to a wallet. Despite the significant movement of funds, the chain's records indicate that the peg still remains in balance. Further investigations into the nature of the transaction and the message are ongoing.

title: White hat hacker drains ~4,200 BTC from Liquid Network, worth $320M
summary:
The incident raises critical concerns about the security and trustworthiness of federated sidechain models, necessitating urgent scrutiny.
The post White hat hacker drains ~4,200 BTC from Liquid Network, worth $320M appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: A white hat hacker successfully drained approximately 4,200 Bitcoin from the Liquid Network, with the funds valued at $320 million. This major incident has raised critical security concerns regarding federated sidechain models. Experts emphasize the urgent need for heightened scrutiny and stronger protective measures to secure these blockchain networks against future vulnerabilities.
